note: Both sets agree on the shared claims and read the dimensions correctly, but they differ in the extras. Set A adds bolt length (4") and diameter (3/8") claims that merely restate its own 3/8" x 4" dimensions claim, while omitting the plywood deck material entirely. Set B instead captures the 3/4" x 5 1/2" PLYWOOD DECK fact (thickness), a real material spec that A misses, though B leaves out its 5 1/2" width. Overall B carries more distinct, supported engineering information and less redundancy.
remarks: Both sets bind the bare dimensions 1 1/4" and 3 3/4" to 'deck module section' although in the text layer they appear among the footing-detail dimensions (4 1/4", 4 1/4", 3 3/4", 1 1/4") near A6; the binding is shared so it does not affect the comparison, but it is worth verifying against the image. 'span 5-6' is a vague entity for the 8'-0" dimension in both sets. The text layer is a flat dump of labels with no positional association, so several bindings (e.g. 1'-0" to LANDSCAPE FOOTING width) cannot be confirmed from the text alone.
